question: \( {x}^{2}+\frac{1}{{x}^{2}} \) এর নিম্নোত্ত কোন মানের জন্য \( {x}^{3}-\frac{1}{{x}^{3}}=0 \) হবে ?
explanation:
🔖দেয়া আছে, \( {x}^{3}- \frac{1}{{3}^{3}} =0 \)
বা, \( \left(x- \frac{1}{x}\right)\left({x}^{2}+x.\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}\right) =0 \)
বা,\( \left(x- \frac{1}{x}\right)\left({x}^{2}+\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}+1\right) =0 \)
\( \therefore x -\frac{1}{x}=0 \left[\because {x}^{2}+\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}+1 \not\equiv 0\right] \)
বা, \( {\left(x- \frac{1}{x}\right)}^{2}=0 \) [উভয়পক্ষে বর্গ করে]
বা, \( {x}^{2} -2.x.+\frac{1}{x}+\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}=0 \)
\( \therefore {x}^{2} +\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}=2 \)
